title: Doha NO2 leads TTF returns (short)
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Doha CAMS NO2 20d z-score > 1 signals Ras Laffan restart and leads TTF log returns by 3 days (-); trade short TTF=F 5d [airquality.doha.cams_no2 -> finance.TTF=F.log_return]
message: Not a rule: short TTF=F on Doha NO2 z>1 gives hit 46% n=56, excess +0.2%/trade overall but war test n=20 hit 35% excess -0.19%; actionability 2.14, r=-0.066 perm p=0.77.

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.doha.cams_no2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Doha CAMS NO2 20d z-score > 1 (reversal control: Ras Laffan activity proxy was a losing short in the war test) leads TTF log returns by 3 days (+); trade long TTF=F 3d [airquality.doha.cams_no2 -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0028)
